title: DCP Twisted-Convolution Pretty Good Measurement Gram Bridge
claims: The uniform-prior ensemble operator E_rho is block-diagonal across collision fibers F_y = {u : A u == y mod q} with eigenvalues c(y)/2^m.
The Pretty Good Measurement (PGM) success probability equals (sum_y sqrt(c(y)))^2 / (Q * 2^m) <= |Im(A mod q)| / Q.
Includes the bijective constructive control A=[[1,2]] mod 4 achieving P_PGM = 1.0.
